verdicts.strongest_argument: The filing is reachable and its circulation in this capture is genuinely nil, so it sits in the reachable-but-unconnected band - but one detail in the finding's own description pushes it toward the top of that band rather than the bottom. The 8-K carries item 9.01, which means an exhibit was furnished, and the finding correctly reads that as a press release. A company that issues a press release has distributed the news on a wire to every subscriber; the fact that this capture ran no news search (n_queries=0 in every sweep) and stored only a Stocktwits dump is why the announcement is invisible here, and that is a capture artefact rather than evidence the market did not see it. So the most likely state of the world is that the change was publicly announced on 2026-08-28 and simply is not in this corpus. Beyond that, the finding cannot carry a sign: no body is stored, item 5.02 covers appointments as readily as departures, and the hunter's stated basis for leaning negative - 'companies time departures to just before a results release rather than just after' - is a base-rate assertion with no source and no obvious truth to it. The 13D/A of 06-26 and the Reg FD 8-K of 06-17 are further unread item codes. At a $207m issuer with 70,415 shares a day of volume, this is also a name where the print itself carries a 14.05% median reaction, so an unquantified governance item is small relative to the event it precedes.
